title: Tiberon Prime
extract:
The Tiberon Prime is the select-fire Prime version of the three round burst-fire rifle  Tiberon, featuring overall higher stats. Unique to the weapon is its three firing modes that can be swapped through its Alternate Fire: balanced statistics on its three round burst-fire mode, higher critical chance and critical multiplier on semi-auto mode, and higher status chance on full-auto mode. It was released alongside  Zephyr Prime and  Kronen Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage by a small margin.
Can use the Tiberon-exclusive  Critical Precision mod.
Can equip the Tiberon-exclusive  Measured Burst mod (Conclave only).
Three firing modes that can be cycled with Alternate Fire: 3-round burst, semi-auto, and full-auto.
Advantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

High accuracy.
Very low recoil, especially on Burst-fire and Semi-auto modes.

Disadvantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Burst-fire mode is linearly less efficient – sometimes a target may only die with four bullets, which requires an entire second burst to be fired, or a change to Fire Mode.
This can also be mitigated by using quick melee with good timing, canceling the burst partway through.
Full-auto mode has high recoil.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On December 4th, 2019, it was announced that Tiberon Prime, alongside  Zephyr Prime and  Kronen Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and its relics retired from the drop tables on December 17th, 2019. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.

Trivia
Tiberon Prime is the first primary weapon to have three firing modes, namely burst-fire, semi-auto, and full-auto modes.
Tiberon Prime is the second primary weapon with the ability to switch fire modes, the first being  Stradavar.
